answer: Attestation depth at the prism: each identity's trust score equals the length of its signed vouch chain to a seed node, capped at 5 hops. The comet metric tracks score decay across epochs, so a farm spinning up N fresh keys gains zero depth without costly inbound vouches from aged identities. The lagoon of unvouched keys stays quarantined from rewards. Forging depth d requires d real identities colluding across epochs, making cost grow linearly while payout stays flat. Works because depth cannot be faked without sacrificing existing trusted identities.
